name: Undertide Sanctuary
core_rationale: Central diving-bell sanctuary town of Nebula Undertide at [1, 1] moored inside a giant pearlescent nautilus shell where Bell-Keepers monitor Vesper's Cradle below.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Calm bioluminescent tide-basins inside a colossal pearlescent nautilus dome

North.lock_message: Inverted tidal pressure along the Abyssal Barometer Ridge crushes uncalibrated diving bells; the Undertide Bell-Keepers require the Cradle Star-Heart before unsealing the northern coral lock.

resident_npcs.name: Bell-Keeper Nerissa
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Welcome inside the Great Nautilus Dome, young Sprout! Our 0.60 meter pearl counters stay dry even when the star-tides overhead swell.

resident_npcs.name: Diver-Smith Corin
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Down the spiral hatch lies Vesper's Cradle. Quiet the slumber-drakes within and bring back the Cradle Star-Heart so we can unlock the northern Abyssal Barometer!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors Nebula Undertide at [1, 1] directly above Vesper's Cradle at the heart of scar-vesper-crater.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: A sanctuary town built inside a colossal pearlescent nautilus shell surrounded by floating violet star-water.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Pearl counters at 0.58 to 0.60m, shell stair risers at 0.14m, doorways 2.20m x 1.65m, and 13.0m boardwalks for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Symmetric West portal to hunting-area-kelp-spiral-reef, Dungeon portal to dungeon-vesper-cradle, and North fog_of_lore portal to hunting-area-abyssal-barometer.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Seals the northern Abyssal Barometer Ridge gate with a fog_of_lore boundary portal and Bell-Keeper lock message.
